basics.name: Àlex Solé Gómez
basics.label: PhD Candidate in Machine Learning
basics.summary: PhD candidate at Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya working on self-supervised graph neural networks for molecular and crystalline systems.

work.name: Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya - ETSETB TelecomBCN
highlights: Develop graph neural network models for molecular and crystalline systems, with a focus on representation learning and crystal property prediction.
Supervised by Prof. Javier Ruiz-Hidalgo and Prof. Eliseo Ruiz.

work.name: Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya - ETSETB TelecomBCN
highlights: Teach undergraduate and graduate material connected to machine learning, signal processing, and engineering.

work.name: Institute of Theoretical and Computational Chemistry, Universitat de Barcelona
highlights: Worked on graph neural networks for crystal property prediction within the AIQUANEURO project.
Collaborated with computational chemistry researchers on molecular and crystalline systems.

work.name: OPIT - Open Institute of Technology
highlights: Teach machine learning and computer vision topics in remote programs.

work.name: Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia
highlights: Worked on few-shot image retrieval constrained by knowledge graphs for image geolocalisation in the MEMEX-EU project.
Supervised by Prof. Alessio Del Bue and Asst. Prof. Stuart James.

work.name: Vicomtech
highlights: Worked on European and internal projects involving scene text recognition, person detection, person re-identification, federated learning, and data visualization.
Supervised by Prof. Oihana Otaegui and collaborators.

work.name: Delft University of Technology
highlights: Built a dataset and deep learning pipeline for detecting floating plastic debris from Sentinel-2 satellite imagery.
Supervised by Prof. Elmar Eisemann and Dr. Leonardo Scandolo.

work.name: Pervasive Technologies
highlights: Prepared datasets for client projects and wrote Python, Bash, and Docker tooling for model training on Google Cloud Platform.
Built APIs for deploying machine learning systems to client workflows.

work.name: Dispromedia
highlights: Built scripts that extracted content from client websites and used it to generate dynamic mobile app views.
